entities.name: Masjid Ahmad Ibrahim
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Masjid Ahmad Ibrahim is a mosque located along Jalan Ulu Seletar, between the areas of Yishun and Thomson, Singapore. It is named after Ahmad bin Ibrahim, a Singaporean politician and the former Minister for Labour from 1959–1961.
